name: Cube-Intersection Graph Representation Classes
statement: The graphs $Q(G)$ arising from $p$-expansion graphs are exactly the chordal graphs; those from median $p$-expansion graphs are exactly the Helly chordal graphs; those from ACC graphs are exactly the dually chordal graphs; and those from ACC $p$-expansion graphs are exactly the doubly chordal graphs.
comments: Each converse asserts existence of a representing graph in the stated class. It does not turn a property of $Q(G)$ into membership of an arbitrary given $G$.
